groups.operation: Parse a four-component OBJ v line in parseVertexWithColor and LoadObj.
groups.condition: The v line has a single fourth component after its position coordinates.
groups.capability: Retain that component in vertex_weights and publish it in the output attributes.
groups.consequence: The vertex weight is lost or not published.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe the same fourth-component parsing and vertex_weights output behavior.

groups.operation: Parse an OBJ vertex through LoadObj with config.vertex_color controlling color fallback.
groups.condition: config.vertex_color disables fallback and the vertex has no RGB components.
groups.capability: Accept the vertex without supplying fallback colors.
groups.consequence: The vertex is rejected or fallback colors are supplied.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe the same disabled color-fallback behavior for a vertex without RGB components.

groups.operation: Export a polygon face through exportGroupsToShape using config.triangulate.
groups.capability: Preserve the polygon face without triangulating it, if supported.
groups.consequence: The polygon is triangulated or not preserved as a polygon face.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe the same conditional polygon-export behavior.
